title: Upload path traversal attempts against Demo App
summary: We assess as attempts against FOILED-DEMO-0001 from several sources, first seen on Foiled sensors before the advisory.
body_md:
## What we saw

We assess as attempts against FOILED-DEMO-0001: uploads that climb out of the upload directory with `../` segments.

## Behaviour

1. A probe of `/api/upload`.
2. An upload with a traversal path.
3. A request for the dropped file.

Sources included 203.0.113.21 and 198[.]51[.]100[.]40, which are documentation addresses in this example.
